en.headline: Sun Dong says market partners will speed San Tin site formation
en.dek: The innovation chief said two to three hectares at San Tin Technopole could be released from late this year, ahead of the original post-2030 timetable.
body: Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong said the government will use market forces to bring forward primary land development at San Tin Technopole, including site formation and infrastructure, so innovation firms can move in earlier.

Hong Kong's first five-year plan projects about 900 hectares of formed land in the Northern Metropolis over the next five years, of which 400 hectares is earmarked for industry. About 100 hectares of that industrial land is meant to prepare San Tin Technopole. Sun said most of that land had been scheduled after 2030, but the bureau is in talks with several large companies and will work with the Development Bureau to adjust the programme if projects firm up.

He expected two to three hectares to be released first between the end of this year and early next year. Tender scoring for the Hong Kong–Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park in the Loop and the Sha Ling data park already gives about 70 percent weight to local GDP contribution, jobs, research talent and technological lead, and Sun said San Tin would follow the same public standard toward a target of new industries making up 5.5 percent of GDP by 2030.

zh.headline: 孫東：用市場力量提前平整新田科技城用地
zh.dek: 創科及工業局局長稱會提早推進一級土地開發，預料年底至明年初率先釋出兩至三公頃，較原定2030年後產出為早。
body: 創新科技及工業局局長孫東表示，為配合創科產業盡早落地，當局將利用市場力量，提早推進新田科技城的一級土地開發，包括土地平整及基礎設施工程。
香港首個五年規劃提出，北部都會區未來五年預計產出900公頃熟地，當中400公頃為產業用地，約100公頃是為新田科技城產業發展作準備。孫東說，原定大部分土地要到2030年後才產出，但當局正與多家大型企業洽商產業落地，若落實將聯同發展局因地制宜、搶時間加速度。
他預計新田科技城今年底至明年初將率先釋出兩至三公頃土地。當局就河套香港園區及沙嶺數據園區招標時，高達七成評標比重視乎企業對本地生產總值的貢獻、帶動本地就業、引入科研人才及科技引領能力。孫東說未來新田科技城亦會沿用這套公開標準，邁向2030年新型工業佔本地生產總值5.5%的目標。
